docs.text:
# Alpha desk

The alpha desk module answers incoming calls for a small workshop.

## What it does not do

The alpha desk module never takes card payments over the phone. A member of staff handles every payment.

## Set-up

Set-up takes two working days and needs the opening hours of the workshop.

# Beta mail

The beta mail module sorts the shared inbox into folders.

## Limits

The beta mail module never deletes a message. Sorting is the only change it makes to the inbox.

## Set-up

Set-up needs read access to the shared inbox and a list of folder names.

# Rate card

Every estimate is indicative until a person confirms the volumes.

## Surcharges

Urgent requests carry a surcharge of twenty percent on the monthly fee. Exporting records as CSV carries no surcharge.

# Case: a bakery stops losing orders

This is an invented case about a bakery that took orders by telephone.

## What changed

The bakery used the alpha desk module for calls, and the number of missed orders fell in the first month. Staff kept control of the payment step.
